behavior_ir.evidence: The production planning authority builds the canonical Behavior IR through the semantic-binding wrapper before obligation compilation.

obligation_source.evidence: The production planning authority compiles formal obligations directly from the resolved Behavior IR.

planner.evidence: The public discovery runtime delegates planning to the semantic-bound planning wrapper used by the V12 production mainline.

experiment_compiler.evidence: The production planning authority compiles selected obligations through the canonical experiment compiler, including fail-closed fallback variants.

executor.evidence: The experiment-candidate runtime sends scheduled formal experiments through the governed public executor.

evidence_pipeline.evidence: The canonical enterprise scan persists normalized execution evidence and fails safe when evidence persistence fails.

oracle.evidence: The canonical outcome finalizer composes the Contract Oracle evaluator into exact-scope finalization before findings are emitted.

finding_pipeline.evidence: The canonical outcome finalizer materializes deterministic finding occurrences from violated outcome identities and Oracle receipts.

delivery_gate.evidence: Each delivery occurrence is evaluated by the shipped v2 customer-delivery gate, not the compatibility shim.

release_decision.evidence: The scan release boundary evaluates campaign, execution, evidence, test-data, findings, coverage gaps and release policy through the release gate.
